info.name: Sport API
info.description:
Backend API gateway for TheSportsDB with Laravel Sanctum authentication and per-user favorite teams.

All responses use one envelope: { "success": bool, "message": string, "data": mixed }.

How to use:
1. Run Register (or Login). The Sanctum token is set as the HttpOnly cookie api_token (it is not in the response body) and Postman stores it in its cookie jar automatically.
2. Protected requests then authenticate through that cookie.
3. POST/DELETE requests must send the header X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest (already included).

TheSportsDB responses are cached by Laravel for 10 minutes (file cache store). The frontend never calls TheSportsDB directly.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login and logout using Laravel Sanctum personal access tokens.

request.description:
Create a new user account. The API token is returned as the HttpOnly cookie api_token.

Auth: public.

Body: name (required, max 255), email (required, unique), password (required, min 8), password_confirmation (must match password).

Responses: 201 created (data.user, plus the api_token cookie), 422 validation error.

Log in with email and password. The API token is returned as the HttpOnly cookie api_token.

Auth: public.

Body: email (required), password (required).

Responses: 200 success (data.user, plus the api_token cookie), 401 invalid credentials, 422 validation error.

Profile of the authenticated user (id, name, email) for the private profile page.

Auth: login cookie (api_token) required.

Responses: 200 success, 401 unauthenticated.

Revoke the token used for this request (other tokens stay valid).

Auth: login cookie (api_token) required.

Responses: 200 success, 401 unauthenticated.

item.name: Leagues
item.description: League data proxied from TheSportsDB. Public endpoints, cached for 10 minutes.

request.description:
List sports (Soccer, Basketball, ...). Use a strSport value as the sport query of List Leagues.

Auth: public.

Cache key: thesportsdb.sports

Responses: 200 success, 502 if TheSportsDB is unavailable.

List leagues (name, sport, logo in strBadge) from TheSportsDB. strBadge is null when the free tier has no logo for that league.

Auth: public.

Query: sport (optional) - filter by sport name, e.g. Soccer or Basketball. Omit to list all sports.

Cache key: thesportsdb.leagues.{sport}

Responses: 200 success, 502 if TheSportsDB is unavailable.

List all teams in a league.

Auth: public.

Path: league - TheSportsDB league ID (idLeague from List Leagues), e.g. 4328 = English Premier League.

Cache key: thesportsdb.league_teams.{leagueId}

Responses: 200 success (empty array if the league is unknown), 502 if TheSportsDB is unavailable.

League standings (points table).

Auth: public.

Path: league - TheSportsDB league ID.
Query: season (optional) - e.g. 2020-2021. Defaults to the current season.

Note: TheSportsDB only supports standings for featured soccer leagues.

Cache key: thesportsdb.league_table.{leagueId}.{season|current}

Responses: 200 success, 502 if TheSportsDB is unavailable.

item.name: Teams
item.description: Team data proxied from TheSportsDB. Public endpoints, cached for 10 minutes.

request.description:
Details of a single team (name, badge, stadium, description, etc.).

Auth: public.

Path: team - TheSportsDB team ID, e.g. 133604 = Arsenal.

Cache key: thesportsdb.team.{teamId}

Responses: 200 success, 404 team not found, 502 if TheSportsDB is unavailable.

Recent past matches of a team. Match time is converted from UTC to Indonesian Western Time (WIB, Asia/Jakarta) in the field match_time_wib.

Auth: public.

Path: team - TheSportsDB team ID.

Cache key: thesportsdb.team_previous.{teamId}

Note: the free TheSportsDB key only returns home events.

Responses: 200 success, 502 if TheSportsDB is unavailable.

item.name: Favorites
item.description: Favorite teams stored in the local PostgreSQL database. All endpoints require the login cookie and only touch the authenticated user's own favorites.

request.description:
List all favorite teams of the authenticated user, newest first.

Auth: login cookie (api_token) required.

Responses: 200 success, 401 unauthenticated.

Add a team to the authenticated user's favorites. Ownership comes from the token, never from the request body.

Auth: login cookie (api_token) required.

Body: team_id (required, TheSportsDB team ID), team_name (required), team_badge (optional URL).

Responses: 201 created, 401 unauthenticated, 409 team already in favorites, 422 validation error.

Remove a team from the authenticated user's favorites.

Auth: login cookie (api_token) required.

Path: favorite - the favorite record ID (the id field from List Favorites, not the TheSportsDB team ID). Set the collection variable favorite_id.

Responses: 200 success, 401 unauthenticated, 404 not found or not owned by the user.
